text:
Maya Rao: FYI — ACME prod asked to onboard polaris-lite-6.2b (FP16 upstream). They want prioritized quant experiments (int8 then int4), low-latency canary, and HIPAA-safe private deployment. Can we triage and set a short checklist?
Arjun Patel: Quick clarifying q: do they need FP8/hybrid or strictly int8->int4? Any sample prompts or target tasks?
Olivia Chen: They listed two main workloads: chat completions (multi-turn) and embedding extraction for search. Sent a small sample prompt set and expected queries in the ticket: <https://acme.internal/reqs/polaris-lite>. Customer also flagged 99p latency <450ms for 512 tokens.
Maya Rao: Link pasted in thread. Customer also needs per-token cost estimate and a regression safety net before rollout.
Devon Lee: Infra note: our Dedicated pool can host 6.2b models but int4 kernels on current A100 infra need the new runtime build. Canary on T4 is possible for latency sim but may understate 99p. We'll need compatibility matrix run.
Sam Rivera: I'll put together an initial eval harness: 1k prompt set (from customer + synthetic), metrics: exact match, BLEU, perplexity, hallucination flags, and embedding cosine drift vs baseline. Also will add a few safety/regression prompts.
Arjun Patel: Proposed plan: 1) Ingest weights + run int8 quant smoke (act-ordering, per-channel) 2) Run token-level perf + 100-qps latency sim on canary 3) Compare quality vs FP16 baseline; if within tolerance, try int4 with fallback policy.
Olivia Chen: :thumbsup: Customer insists on HIPAA handling => private deployment + KMS. They want a canary before dev rollout. Budget isn't infinite; they asked for cost delta estimate.
Devon Lee: For HIPAA: need VPC private control plane, KMS/HSM integration. On-prem or VPC can add ~2 weeks infra lead time. Canary can be done in private region though. Cost delta estimate: int8 on dedicated GPUs roughly +18% over FP16 due to infra overhead; int4 uncertain until kernels are in stable runtime.
QuantBot: AUTO: Created ticket INF-7892: polaris-lite-6.2b onboarding. Checklist created: [ingest -> quantize:int8 -> smoke test -> eval harness -> canary rollout -> int4 trial -> SLA signoff]. Assigned: eng-ml, eng-infra, product.
Maya Rao: Next actions: Arjun to run quant pipeline + smoke; Sam to prepare eval deck; Devon to reserve canary node and confirm kernel/runtime parity; Olivia to confirm HIPAA/legal ok with customer and gather billing acceptance. Target: initial int8 smoke by EOD Friday.
Arjun Patel: I can do int8 smoke by EOD Fri. Need weights S3 path and Docker tag. Also will include a small script to collect KV cache hit stats.
Maya Rao: Weights at s3://redwood-onboard/polaris-lite/6.2b/v1. I'll DM creds. Use runtime tag rwd-infer:2026-03-15-rc for kernel testing.
Sam Rivera: Eval metrics I'll track: EM, BLEU, perplexity, hallucination rate (prompt-specific), embedding cosine drift (mean+std), and token-generation divergence. I'll push a reproducible notebook to the ticket.
Olivia Chen: Reminder: customer wants canary SLA: 7-day canary with automatic rollback if hallucination rate >2x baseline or 99p latency exceeds 500ms.
Devon Lee: Noted. For rollback automation we need the rollout controller config updated (canary window + automatic fallback to FP16). I'll draft the rollout policy.
Arjun Patel: Preliminary quant command I'll run locally:
```
python tools/quantize.py \n  --model s3://redwood-onboard/polaris-lite/6.2b/v1 \n  --scheme per-channel-ada \n  --bits 8 \n  --calib-samples 2048 \n  --output /tmp/polaris-6.2b-int8
```
Will also run sample generation against 100 prompts for smoke.
Maya Rao: Good. Also please estimate per-token cost delta and add to ticket INF-7892. Olivia, note the HIPAA / KMS requirement for accounting.
Olivia Chen: I'll loop in legal and ops. If HIPAA, Private deployment + HSM KMS is a hard requirement. Customer ok to start canary in VPC while we finalize HSM? Need to confirm.
Devon Lee: Possible to do a VPC canary without HSM initially, but can't go GA without KMS/HSM. Risk noted.
Sam Rivera: I'll include regression thresholds and a small smoke dashboard prometheus/grafana panels for hallucination tokens, latency p50/p95/p99, and embedding drift.
Maya Rao: Let's huddle in 30m in #eng-ml-triage to assign tasks and set timeline. Pinged @Arjun @Sam @Devon @Olivia.
Arjun Patel: On it.
Devon Lee: Reserving a canary node now.
QuantBot: AUTO: Reminder set for INF-7892: 72h check-in.
